learning_outcomes.text: Be able to perform stoichiometric calculations and determine concentrations of species in equilibrium reactions.
Be able to use chemical language to name products, reactions and processes.
Be able to differentiate the different types of bonds and their influence on physicochemical properties.
Know how to differentiate different types of chemical reactions.
Know how to balance chemical reactions.
Know the functional groups of organic chemistry and their main reactions.

syllabus_topics: Chemical bond: bond energy, bond length and angle, dipole moment.
Covalent bond: structure (Lewis, VSEPR, VB) and intermolecular forces.
Metallic bond: structure and applications: conductivity and alloys.
Ionic bond: structure, lattice energy and Born-Haber cycle.
Bloc temàtic 2: Concept of chemical reaction: Acids and bases
Brønsted-Lowry protonic theory: acidity or basicity constants.
Strong and weak acids and bases.
Basic concepts, types of complexes and coordination number.
Definitions, electromotive force and standard potential.
Cell potential as a function of concentration: Nernst equation.
Applications: batteries and types of cells, corrosion and passivation, electrolysis.
Bloc temàtic 6: Bases of organic chemistry
Kinetic and thermodynamic control of reactions.
Polymers: classification, polymerization mechanisms and industrial applications of polymers.
Dye industry: mode of action of dyes.
Detergent industry: structure and mode of action of surfactants.
Recovery of aluminum-rich waste. Reactions in test tubes.
Acid/base titration of different chemical products. Synthesis of acetanilide.
teaching_methods: Practical application of concepts and procedures
